items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: My mother's name was Margaret Mary Reid.

ctx.x: My mother's name was Margaret Mary Reid. And this great grandfather said he was married to what was called a Creole woman, which means she was French, Spanish, Indian -- I don't know what. But judging from the pictures she was dark, some kind, which was probably the reason he went to the North when the Civil War started.
